parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description: The language in which you want to display the results. Valid values: zh (default): Chinese. en: English.

parameters.name: ConfigName
parameters.description:
The configuration name of the parameter. Valid values:

- EnableHttp2

- DownstreamIdleTime

- PreserveHeaderFormat

- UpstreamIdleTimeout

- EnableXffTrustedCidrs

- EnableK8sSourceWorkloadFilter

parameters.name: ConfigValue
parameters.description:
The configuration value of the parameter. Examples:

- EnableHttp2

```
true / false
```

- DownstreamIdleTime

```
15
```

- PreserveHeaderFormat

```
true / false
```

- UpstreamIdleTimeout

```
60
```

- EnableXffTrustedCidrs

```json
{"enable":true,"ipListContent":"192.168.1.0/24
2.2.2.2"}
```

- EnableK8sSourceWorkloadFilter

```json
	
{"enable":true,"filterOpt":"EQUAL","labelKey":"key","labelValue":"value"}
```

parameters.name: GatewayUniqueId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the gateway.
